snippet.title: COLOR-A-CUBE - RELEASE DATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Color-A-Cube leaves Early Access and officially launches as version 1.0 on June 18, 2026, on Meta Quest and PICO. This cozy VR color-by-numbers game combines voxel art, crisp interactions, satisfying pops, and sparkling completion effects into a relaxing creative experience. The 1.0 release includes over 100 voxel models, new story-driven coloring experiences, weekly free model drops, monthly DLC releases, and crossover content with other games. Whether you play for a quick break or lose track of time, Color-A-Cube is designed to help players slow down, switch off, and enjoy the simple pleasure of coloring in VR. Meta: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/color-a-cube/8774301352666408/    PICO: https://store-global.picoxr.com/global/detail/1/7573704775435485237
